Alif Laam Meem
Room waale maghloob ho gaye
Qareeb-tareen ilaaqe mein, lekin yeh maghloob ho jaane ke baad anqareeb phir ghaalib ho jaayenge
Chand saal ke andar. Allah hi ke liye awwal o aakhir har zamaane ka ikhtiyaar hai, aur usi din saahibaan-e-imaan khushi manaayenge
Allah ki nusrat o imdaad ke sahaare, ke woh jis ki imdaad chaahta hai kar deta hai, aur woh saahib-e-izzat bhi hai aur meharbaan bhi hai
Yeh Allah ka waada hai aur Allah apne waade ke khilaaf nahin karta hai, magar logon ki aksariyat is haqeeqat se bhi be-khabar hai
Yeh log sirf zindagaani-e-duniya ke zaahir ko jaante hain aur aakhirat ki taraf se bilkul ghaafil hain

Kya un logon ne apne andar fikr nahin ki hai ke Khuda ne aasmaan o zameen aur us ke darmiyaan ki tamaam makhlooqaat ko barhaq hi paida kiya hai aur ek mu'ayyan muddat ke saath? Lekin logon ki aksariyat apne Parwardigar ki mulaaqaat se inkaar karne waali hai

Aur kya un logon ne zameen mein sair nahin ki hai ke dekhte ke un se pehle waalon ka kya anjaam hua hai, jo taaqat mein un se zyaada mazboot the aur unhon ne zaraa'at kar ke zameen ko un se zyaada aabaad kar liya tha, aur un ke paas hamaare numaainde zyaada khuli hui nishaaniyaan bhi le kar aaye the? Yaqeenan Khuda apne bandon par zulm nahin karta hai, balke yeh log khud hi apne oopar zulm karte hain
Us ke baad buraai karne waalon ka anjaam bura hua ke unhon ne Khuda ki nishaaniyon ko jhutla diya aur baraabar un ka mazaaq udaate rahe
Allah hi takhleeq ki ibtida karta hai aur phir palta bhi deta hai, aur phir tum sab usi ki baargaah mein waapas le jaaye jaaoge
Aur jis din qiyaamat qaaim ki jaaegi us din saare mujrimeen maayoos ho jaayenge
Aur un ke shuraka mein koi sifaarish karne waala na hoga, aur yeh khud bhi apne shuraka ka inkaar karne waale honge
Aur jis din qiyaamat qaaim hogi sab log aapas mein girohon mein taqseem ho jaayenge
Pas jo imaan waale aur nek amal waale honge woh baagh-e-Jannat mein nihaal aur khush-haal honge
Aur jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya aur hamaari aayaat aur roz-e-aakhirat ki mulaaqaat ki takzeeb ki woh azaab mein zaroor giraftaar kiye jaayenge
Lihaaza tum log tasbeeh-e-Parwardigar karo us waqt jab shaam karte ho aur jab subah karte ho
Aur zameen o aasmaan mein saari hamd usi ke liye hai, aur asr ke hangaam aur jab dopahar karte ho
Woh Khuda zinda ko murda se aur murda ko zinda se nikaalta hai, aur zameen ko murda ho jaane ke baad phir zinda karta hai, aur isi tarah ek din tumhein bhi nikaala jaaega
Aur us ki nishaaniyon mein se ek yeh bhi hai ke us ne tumhein khaak se paida kiya hai, aur us ke baad tum bashar ki shakl mein phail gaye ho

Aur us ki nishaaniyon mein se yeh bhi hai ke us ne tumhaara joda tum hi mein se paida kiya hai taake tumhein us se sukoon haasil ho, aur phir tumhaare darmiyaan mohabbat aur rehmat qaraar di hai, ke is mein saahibaan-e-fikr ke liye bahut si nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain
Aur us ki nishaaniyon mein se aasmaan o zameen ki khilqat aur tumhaari zabaanon aur tumhaare rangon ka ikhtilaaf bhi hai, ke is mein saahibaan-e-ilm ke liye bahut si nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain

Aur us ki nishaaniyon mein se yeh bhi hai ke tum raat aur din ko aaraam karte ho aur phir fazl-e-Khuda ko talaash karte ho, ke is mein bhi sunne waali qaum ke liye bahut si nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain

Aur us ki nishaaniyon mein se yeh bhi hai ke woh bijli ko khauf aur umeed ka markaz bana kar dikhlaata hai, aur aasmaan se paani barsaata hai, phir us ke zariye murda zameen ko zinda banaata hai. Beshak is mein bhi us qaum ke liye bahut si nishaaniyaan hain jo aql rakhne waali hai
Aur us ki nishaaniyon mein se yeh bhi hai ke aasmaan o zameen usi ke hukm se qaaim hain, aur us ke baad woh jab tum sab ko talab karega to sab zameen se yakbaargi baraamad ho jaayenge
Aasmaan o zameen mein jo kuch bhi hai sab usi ki milkiyat hai aur sab usi ke taabe'-e-farmaan hain

Aur wahi woh hai jo khilqat ki ibtida karta hai aur phir dobaara bhi paida karega, aur yeh kaam us ke liye behadd aasaan hai, aur usi ke liye aasmaan aur zameen mein sab se behtareen misaal hai, aur wahi sab par ghaalib aane waala aur saahib-e-hikmat hai

Us ne tumhaare liye tumhaari hi misaal bayaan ki hai ke jo rizq hum ne tum ko ata kiya hai kya us mein tumhaare mamlook ghulaam o kaneez mein koi tumhaara shareek hai ke tum sab baraabar ho jaao, aur tumhein un ka khauf isi tarah ho jis tarah apne nufoos ke baare mein khauf hota hai? Beshak hum apni nishaaniyon ko saahib-e-aql qaum ke liye isi tarah waazeh kar ke bayaan karte hain

Haqeeqat yeh hai ke zaalimon ne baghair jaane boojhe apni khwaahishaat ka ittibaa' kar liya hai, to jis ko Khuda gumraahi mein chhod de use kaun hidaayat de sakta hai, aur un ka to koi naasir o madadgaar bhi nahin hai

Aap apne rukh ko deen ki taraf rakhein aur baatil se kinaara-kash rahein, ke yeh deen woh fitrat-e-Ilaahi hai jis par us ne insaanon ko paida kiya hai, aur khilqat-e-Ilaahi mein koi tabdeeli nahin ho sakti hai. Yaqeenan yahi seedha aur mustahkam deen hai, magar logon ki aksariyat is baat se bilkul be-khabar hai
Tum sab apni tawajjoh Khuda ki taraf rakho aur usi se darte raho. Namaaz qaaim karo aur khabardaar mushrikeen mein se na ho jaana
Un logon mein se jinhon ne deen mein tafriqa paida kiya hai aur girohon mein bat gaye hain, phir har giroh jo kuch us ke paas hai usi par mast aur magan hai

Aur logon ko jab bhi koi museebat chhoo jaati hai to woh Parwardigar ko poori tawajjoh ke saath pukaarte hain, us ke baad jab woh rehmat ka maza chakha deta hai to un mein se ek giroh shirk karne lagta hai
Taake jo kuch hum ne ata kiya hai us ka inkaar kar de, to tum maze karo, us ke baad to sab ko maaloom hi ho jaaega
Kya hum ne un ke oopar koi daleel naazil ki hai jo un se un ke shirk ke jawaaz ko bayaan karti hai

Aur jab hum insaanon ko rehmat ka maza chakha dete hain to woh khush ho jaate hain, aur jab inhein un ke saabiqa kirdaar ki bina par koi takleef pahunch jaati hai to woh maayoosi ka shikaar ho jaate hain

To kya un logon ne nahin dekha ke Khuda jis ke rizq mein chaahta hai wus'at paida kar deta hai aur jis ke yahaan chaahta hai kami kar deta hai, aur is mein bhi saahib-e-imaan qaum ke liye us ki nishaaniyaan hain

Aur tum qaraabat-daar, miskeen aur ghurbat-zada musaafir ko us ka haq de do, ke yeh un logon ke haq mein khair hai jo razaa-e-Ilaahi ke talabgaar hain, aur wahi haqeeqatan najaat haasil karne waale hain

Aur tum log jo bhi sood dete ho ke logon ke maal mein izaafa ho jaaye to Khuda ke yahaan koi izaafa nahin hota hai, haan jo zakaat dete ho aur us mein razaa-e-Khuda ka iraada hota hai to aise logon ko dugna chaugna de diya jaata hai

Allah hi woh hai jis ne tum sab ko khalq kiya hai, phir rozi di hai, phir maut deta hai, phir zinda karta hai. Kya tumhaare shuraka mein koi aisa hai jo in mein se koi kaam anjaam de sake? Khuda un tamaam cheezon se jinhein yeh sab shareek bana rahe hain paak o paakeeza aur buland o bartar hai
Logon ke haathon ki kamaai ki bina par fasaad khushki aur tari har jagah ghaalib aa gaya hai, taake Khuda un ke kuch aamaal ka maza chakha de, to shaayad yeh log palat kar raaste par aa jaayein
Aap keh dijiye ke zara zameen mein sair kar ke dekho ke tum se pehle waalon ka kya anjaam hua hai jin ki aksariyat mushrik thi
Aur aap apne rukh ko mustaqeem aur mustahkam deen ki taraf rakhein qabl is ke ke woh din aa jaaye jis ki waapasi ka koi imkaan nahin hai, aur jis din log pareshaan ho kar alag alag ho jaayenge
Jo kufr karega woh apne kufr ka zimmedaar hoga, aur jo log nek amal kar rahe hain woh apne liye raah hamwaar kar rahe hain
Taake Khuda imaan aur nek amal karne waalon ko apne fazl se jaza de sake, ke woh kaafiron ko dost nahin rakhta hai

Aur us ki nishaaniyon mein se ek yeh bhi hai ke woh hawaaon ko khush-khabri dene waala bana kar bhejta hai, aur is liye bhi ke tumhein apni rehmat ka maza chakhaaye, aur us ke hukm se kashtiyaan chalein, aur tum apna rizq haasil kar sako, aur shaayad is tarah shukr-guzaar bhi ban jaao

Aur hum ne tum se pehle bahut se rasool un ki qaumon ki taraf bheje hain jo un ke paas khuli hui nishaaniyaan le kar aaye, phir hum ne mujrimeen se intiqaam liya, aur hamaara farz tha ke hum saahibaan-e-imaan ki madad karein

Allah hi woh hai jo hawaaon ko chalaata hai to woh baadalon ko udaati hain, phir woh un baadalon ko jis tarah chaahta hai aasmaan mein phaila deta hai aur use tukde kar deta hai, aur us ke darmiyaan se paani barsaata hai, phir yeh paani un bandon tak pahunch jaata hai jin tak woh pahunchaana chaahta hai to woh khush ho jaate hain
Agarche woh is baarish ke naazil hone se pehle maayoosi ka shikaar ho gaye the

Ab tum rehmat-e-Khuda ke un aasaar ko dekho ke woh kis tarah zameen ko murda ho jaane ke baad zinda kar deta hai. Beshak wahi murdon ko zinda karne waala hai aur wahi har shai par qudrat rakhne waala hai
Aur agar hum zehreeli hawa chala dete aur yeh har taraf mausam-e-khizaan jaisi zardi dekh lete to bilkul hi kufr ikhtiyaar kar lete
To aap murdon ko apni aawaaz nahin suna sakte hain aur behron ko bhi nahin suna sakte hain jab woh munh pher kar chal dein
Aur aap andhon ko bhi un ki gumraahi se hidaayat nahin kar sakte hain. Aap to sirf un logon ko suna sakte hain jo hamaari aayaton par imaan rakhte hain aur musalmaan hain

Allah hi woh hai jis ne tum sab ko kamzori se paida kiya hai, aur phir kamzori ke baad taaqat ata ki hai, aur phir taaqat ke baad kamzori aur za'eefi qaraar di hai. Woh jo chaahta hai paida kar deta hai, ke woh saahib-e-ilm bhi hai aur saahib-e-qudrat bhi hai

Aur jis din qiyaamat qaaim hogi us din mujrimeen qasam kha kar kahenge ke woh ek saa'at se zyaada duniya mein nahin thehre hain. Dar-haqeeqat yeh isi tarah duniya mein bhi iftira-pardaaziyaan kiya karte the
Aur jin logon ko ilm aur imaan diya gaya hai woh kahenge ke tum log Kitaab-e-Khuda ke mutaabiq qiyaamat ke din tak thehre rahe, to yeh qiyaamat ka din hai, lekin tum log be-khabar bane hue ho
Phir aaj zaalimon ko na koi ma'zarat faaida pahunchaaegi aur na un ki koi baat suni jaaegi
Aur hum ne is Quran mein har tarah ki misaal bayaan kar di hai, aur agar aap saari nishaaniyaan le kar bhi aa jaayein to kaafir yahi kahenge ke aap log sirf ahl-e-baatil hain
Beshak isi tarah Khuda un logon ke dilon par mohr laga deta hai jo ilm rakhne waale nahin hain
Lihaaza aap sabr se kaam lein ke Khuda ka waada barhaq hai, aur khabardaar jo log is amr ka yaqeen nahin rakhte hain woh aap ko halka na bana dein
